# Gog

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** household deity (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P3](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Gog is a china dog featuring a white and green coat and a pert black nose. As part of a pair, Gog's head is turned so that the figure looks to the right.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P1](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0001)_

## History

Gog was a decorative figure who, along with [Magog](../character/magog.md), presided over the hearth with dignity and aplomb at Patty's Place while [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends resided there. Gog eventually went on to reside at the hearth of Anne's little house, where Captain Jim took a great fancy to both him and [Magog](../character/magog.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P3](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0003), [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004), [v3 ch.Place P5](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0005), [v3 ch.Place P6](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0006), [v3 ch.Place P7](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P9](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0009), +184 more_
